title: Assault on doctors in Thane: Supreme Court notice to Ramesh Mhatre on plea by State challenging bail
summary: On July 18, the high court had stayed the bail granted by the lower court, called the order "perverse" and asked Ramesh Mhatre to surrender before the police

title: Tata Boeing JV rolls out 400th fuselage for AH-64E Apache from Hyderabad facility
summary: Made in India, for India and the world, the fuselages underpin Apaches flown worldwide, the JV said announcing the milestone

title: Inquiry under way into ₹4-crore cheating complaint against ex-Minister C. Vijayabaskar, Madras High Court told
summary: AIADMK’s Alangudi constituency candidate Dhana Vimal had lodged a complaint accusing C. Vijayabaskar of having taken ₹4.5 crore from him to prove means to meet election expenses

title: Telangana Assembly monsoon session LIVE: Section 22A prohibited lands issue rocks House on first day
summary: The BJP leaders raised the issue of land in the prohibited properties list immediately as the House assembled for the day

title: Mammootty turns 75: Fans celebrate an icon whose passion for cinema never fades
summary: Celebrating his 75th birthday, iconic actor Mammootty was honored by fans and notable figures in Kochi, who gathered at his residence to pay tribute to his illustrious five-decade career in cinema.

title: Congress Dalit legislators condemn BRS MLCs remarks against Telangana Assembly Speaker; demand KCR’s apology

title: Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra sworn in as Chief Justice of Punjab, Haryana HC
summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, whose government had opposed Justice Mishra's appointment, was not present at the oath-taking ceremony

title: Suitcases in hand, fear in their eyes: Hundreds of students flee Satya Niketan after PG collapse
summary: Traumatised students leave overnight for hometowns, relatives’ homes and temporary shelters, refusing to return to their PGs until the MCD conducts safety checks and assures them the buildings are safe
